text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, sterile water remains in shortage. FDA first posted the shortage on 2021-11-23 and lists it as Current. Corvale East holds 95 units (2.7 days); Corvale General holds 293 units (8.3 days).

Why (FDA record): Our product label names Nephron SC, LLC (FEI 3010892830) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1167490 at that plant ended 2022-04-20 and was classified OAI with observations including validation lacking for sterile drug products. That OAI classification occurred 148 days after the shortage posting. Subsequent inspections on 2023-02-10, 2024-02-09, and 2024-09-25 were also classified OAI. The rule‑selected option is to buy from Chartwell RX, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Our position: Current inventory covers less than nine days at both sites. The Nephron plant has repeated OAI classifications. Chartwell RX, LLC is not on the FDA shortage list and is the rule‑selected source.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to execute purchase from Chartwell RX, LLC; requires buyer approval.
2. If Chartwell supply is unavailable, treating prescriber to authorize substitution to Hospira, Inc. sterile water (NDC change, no clinical change); approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-05-18; requires treating prescriber approval.

Not recommended: No other sourcing or protocol changes at this time.
